description: This file defines a React component 'MessageActions' which provides user interface actions for chat messages, such as edit, copy, pin, delete, resend, and stop. It includes the creation of an actions menu and various handlers for message interactions within a chat application.

methods.name: genActionsShema
methods.description: Generates an array of action objects representing each user interaction available for a chat message, such as edit, copy, pin, delete, resend, and stop. Each action includes an icon, title, and click handler.

methods.name: MessageActions
methods.description: Main React functional component that renders action buttons for individual chat messages and handles their logic, including message editing, copying, pinning, deleting, resending, and stopping message responses.
